skill.displayName: 商誉减值测试底稿核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The skill is a local goodwill-impairment worksheet checker with no observed network, persistence, credential use, or file-writing behavior, but it has documentation inconsistencies that users should notice.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash access are proportionate for a local file-based checker that the user invokes with an input path; no automatic broad indexing or credential/session access was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package install, remote retrieval, dependency installation, or build step was found; the runnable script uses Node standard-library modules and the bundled engine.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly focused on running the bundled Node checker against user-provided material; the Chinese-only interface and stale source text may confuse non-Chinese users or reviewers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, scheduled task, privilege escalation, file writing, or destructive action was found. The script claims anonymous stats in text, but the inspected code contains no network implementation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose and implemented calculations mostly align around goodwill impairment table checks, but stale comments and one empty-input message reference share-based-payment worksheets.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable running a local Chinese-language Node checker on goodwill impairment worksheet text. Treat its output as a deterministic consistency check, not accounting or audit advice, and be aware that some source comments and one empty-input message incorrectly mention share-based-payment worksheets.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Partly supported as a quality/coherence issue: the implementation is actually goodwill-focused, but stale share-based-payment references appear in source comments and one empty-input path. This does not show hidden tool behavior or exfiltration.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded after inspection: scripts/run.mjs and the engine file were present and fully inspected in this review.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported as a documentation mismatch, not malicious behavior: the file header and one insufficiency message mention share-based payment, while the executable logic checks goodwill impairment fields.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only interface is expected for this Chinese accounting worksheet skill, though it should be clearer in the listing for users who need another locale.
